prompt: Show me all the orders that are currently delayed.
notes: Broad anomaly listing with a status filter.

prompt: Which orders have a failed payment right now?
notes: Broad anomaly listing, different status filter phrasing.

prompt: List every anomalous order in the system right now.
notes: Broad anomaly listing with no status filter.

prompt: What's the current status of order ORD-0002?
notes: Plain single-order status check, not a root-cause question.

prompt: Give me the full details for order ORD-0005.
notes: Plain single-order details lookup.

prompt: Look up order ORD-9999 for me.
notes: Edge case: a nonexistent order ID. Tool routing is still deterministic even though the tool's own result will be a not-found response.

prompt: What products are running low on stock?
notes: Inventory alert listing, reorder-threshold phrasing.

prompt: Show me the items that are completely out of stock.
notes: Inventory alert listing, outOfStockOnly phrasing.

prompt: How many units of SKU-ELEC-001 do we currently have in stock?
notes: Single-SKU stock level lookup.

prompt: Check the inventory level for SKU-HOME-003.
notes: Single-SKU stock level lookup, different SKU.

prompt: Tell me about product SKU-APRL-002 — what is it and how much does it cost?
notes: Single-SKU product details lookup.

prompt: What are the specs and price for SKU-ELEC-004?
notes: Single-SKU product details lookup, different SKU.

prompt: List all products in the Electronics category.
notes: Category browse, a known category.

prompt: Show me everything you sell in Home & Garden.
notes: Category browse, a different known category.

prompt: What products do you sell in the Outdoor category?
notes: Edge case: an unsupported category. Tool routing is still deterministic even though the category filter itself will find nothing.

prompt: Why is order ORD-0003 delayed? I need the root cause, not just its status.
notes: Explicit cross-service 'why' investigation.

prompt: Investigate why order ORD-0007 keeps failing.
notes: Explicit cross-service 'why' investigation, different order.

prompt: Can you dig into why order ORD-0001 is stuck and cross-check it against inventory and product data?
notes: Explicit cross-service investigation, phrased around the cross-referencing itself.

prompt: What's the reason order ORD-0009 keeps failing? Check across every service, not just the order itself.
notes: Paired with case-023 on the same order ID to probe the plain-status vs. root-cause routing boundary.

prompt: Please refund order ORD-0004 in full.
notes: Refund request, full amount implied.

prompt: I need to issue a $25 refund on order ORD-0006 for a damaged item.
notes: Refund request with an explicit partial amount and reason.

prompt: Cancel order ORD-0008 — the customer no longer wants it.
notes: Cancellation request with a reason.

prompt: Please cancel order ORD-0002. They changed their mind.
notes: Cancellation request, different order and phrasing.

prompt: Is order ORD-0009 still on track?
notes: Paired with case-024 on the same order ID: a plain status check must not be routed to the root-cause investigation tool.
